en: A black-and-white photograph depicting a festive parade on a crowded street. People in traditional Balkan folk attire march through the center holding a banner that reads 'ТРЪСТЕНИШКА ОБЩИНА' (Trŭstenishka Obshchina) and a flag. Onlookers, including men in uniforms and hats, line both sides of the street as well as the balconies. The surrounding architecture consists of European-style buildings, featuring awnings and balconies, suggesting an early to mid-20th century urban setting.
